video_title: Ronin Made This Log Bait Deck 100X MORE BROKEN

Just want to keep being as aggressive as possible" (1398-1401s), "Just barrel here cuz he's spamming everything" (1418s). Seven Goblin Barrels in 200 seconds, six of them on the same tower.

Possible hero variant, unconfirmed: four own 2-elixir drops with no hand change (t=1263.8, 1332.3, 1399.4, 1421.8) fit the Heroic Magic Archer's 2-elixir Triple Threat ability, two of them within seconds of a Magic Archer deploy label, but Wall Breakers also cost 2 and the commentary never names the ability.

ronin: t=1289.1s (clock unknown): Ronin at [12, 13], elixir 7.0 -> 2.0, behind a Fire Spirit as the defensive mini-tank - "Can just Okay, Fire Spirit and then Ronan" (1287s), then "Very good defense. Ability wouldn't really do too much. Ronan's still going to live regardless" (1291-1294s).

t=1356.5s at [8, 10], chosen by lane rather than by target - "Let's Fire Spirit here or for the low Ronan opposite because he might Cannon Cart at the bridge" (1354-1358s), with Rascals and a Little Prince crossing.

t=1385.4s deploy label at [4, 14] on the left, alongside "Still want a royal knight at the bridge. Help take this out" (1386-1388s) - the transcript's "royal knight" most likely being the Ronin. In this log-bait list he is the only card above 4 elixir and is used purely as the defensive anchor that then walks forward.
mortar: Opponent's win condition (Evolved). Tracked at [6, 16] t=1255.3, [9, 16] t=1311.3 and t=1383.4, [15, 17] t=1357.4, [14, 16] t=1421.4. Ryley identifies the archetype from it at 1246s: "Okay, he has mortar bait. That's going to be some damage."

He answers it with a Magic Archer pierce rather than a building or a walk-in - "I think I want to Magic Archer this. Just to take this out for no hits" (1314-1316s) - and respects the evolution: "He has Evo Mortar in hand though. Have to be really cautious of the Evo Mortar" (1349-1353s). barbarian-barrel: The opponent's answer to his Goblin Barrel, and the card the whole game is measured against. bullets: Video title and framing: "Ronin Made This Log Bait Deck 100X MORE BROKEN" - classic log bait (Goblin Barrel + Wall Breakers double win condition, Ice Spirit/Fire Spirit cycle) with Ronin as the mini-tank and Royal Delivery + Bomb Tower as the defensive core. Goblin Barrel and Wall Breakers are the two evolution slots ("We already have the Evo Barrel", 1267-1270s; "the Evo Wall Breakers at the bridge", 1305s).

Piloting pattern in this game (video seconds; the clock OCR failed all video): every defensive rotation is immediately converted into a barrel. Goblin Barrel at t=1242.6, 1271.3, 1300.3, 1329.3, 1343.3, 1368.4, 1399.4, 1417.4 - seven of the eight on the left tower - with Wall Breakers in the opposite lane at t=1273.3, 1304.3, 1343.3, 1361.7, 1393.4, 1410.6. Enemy left tower 4858 -> 164 HP; his own towers only reach 4583/4070.

Defence is done entirely with the four cheap cards so the win conditions stay free: Royal Delivery six times, Fire Spirit nine times, Ice Spirit seven-plus times, Bomb Tower only three times - "we want to go for the Ice Spirit as well so you don't have to waste a Bomb Tower on defense" (1339-1342s). Ryley names Royal Delivery as the card that makes the aggressive Magic Archer safe: "Usually these aggressive magic archers will go unpunished with the royal delivery in your deck" (1229-1233s).

The deck wins by cycle arithmetic against another bait deck: "I did out-cycle his Barbarian Barrel and he has no Goblins to cycle either so he probably has to Fireball this and then I can just go for the Evo Wall Breakers at the bridge and if he mortars he's just completely in a terrible cycle I think for the rest of the game" (1300-1310s). From that point the barrels are unanswerable and he never stops: "Just keep up the pressure. Just want to keep being as aggressive as possible" (1398-1401s).

Ronin's job in the list is narrow: two to three plays (t=1289.1 [12, 13], t=1356.5 [8, 10], t=1385.4 [4, 14]), always as the defensive mini-tank on his own half that then walks forward, and chosen by lane against the expected Cannon Cart (1354-1358s). The Magic Archer slot may be the Heroic Magic Archer - four unattributed 2-elixir drops match Triple Threat - but the commentary never confirms it.

new_deck.rationale: Goblin Barrel and Wall Breakers are twin cheap win conditions whose whole purpose is to overload the opponent's small-spell and swarm answers, with a 1-elixir spirit pair to cycle back to them.
new_deck.why_it_works_md: The two evolved bait cards (Goblin Barrel, Wall Breakers) attack the same tower on rotation, so the opponent must hold a small spell and a swarm answer at all times or lose the tower in pieces. Because Royal Delivery, Fire Spirit, Ice Spirit and Bomb Tower cover air, ground swarms and buildings between them, Ryley almost never has to spend a win condition on defence - which is why he can play a Magic Archer at the bridge as early as t=1219 and treat a Fireball answer as a profit ("he fireballs and we get a free 400 damage on the tower", 1225-1227s). Ronin replaces the traditional Knight as the mini-tank: 5 elixir buys a much stronger defensive body whose parry punishes the melee answers bait decks lean on, at the cost of a heavier cycle. Against another bait deck the plan is explicitly a cycle race - out-cycle the Barbarian Barrel and the Goblins, then barrel every rotation (1300-1310s).
